_doc: Pinned pass criteria. The Test Director (AGY) and any model may not edit this file; it is hash-pinned by the runner.
verdictRule: PASS only if: every required check passed, no required check is missing, the oracle passed, and no boundary violation occurred. Checks in allowedNotRun do not fail the run but are listed as residual gaps and lower coverage.

requirements.title: Two companies invite each other in both directions; colleagues join their own organisation
checks: T1 A signs in and creates an organisation
T1 A creates a project (main room appears)
T1 A invites company B by e-mail
T1 a different e-mail cannot use the invitation
T1 B accepts with its own new organisation and enters the room
T1 reverse: B creates a project, invites A, A joins with its existing organisation
colleagues join their own organisations by invitation

requirements.title: Multi-person real chat: delivery, reload persistence, fresh sign-in, paging
checks: T1 both sides exchange real messages
T1 history survives reload and a fresh sign-in
T6 history paging on real data (70 extra messages)

requirements.title: Sub rooms, internal rooms and deliberate sharing back
checks: T2 A creates a cross-company sub room with chosen members only
T2 invited member talks in the sub room; uninvited colleague cannot see it
T2/T5 sub room messages do not leak into the main room
T2 a summary is sent back to the main room on purpose
T5 internal sub room is invisible to the other organisation

requirements.title: File upload, versions, hash verification, compare, restore
checks: T3 B uploads v1 then v2 of the same file
T3 server verifies uploads; original bytes of an old version download with the registered hash
T3 two versions open side by side with their differences marked
T3 restoring v1 creates v4 with v1 bytes and no confirmations; v2 confirmations untouched

requirements.title: Per-organisation approval bound to one file version and hash
checks: T3 organisation A confirms v2; B is still unconfirmed
T3 organisation B confirms v2 independently
T3 v3 starts unconfirmed; v2 keeps both confirmations

requirements.title: AI analysis is private to the asker, sourced, never auto-published (stub model)
checks: AI(stub model) summary is private, sectioned, and its sources jump to real messages
AI(stub model) explains and translates one message for the reader only
T2 AI(stub model) proposes a split; nothing is created until A confirms; unknown people are not added
T5 AI refuses a room the caller cannot access (403 before any model call)

requirements.title: Permission isolation with 2 organisations and 4 accounts; removal takes effect
checks: T5 removed room member loses the room
T5 member removed from the organisation loses every room, file row and file object

requirements.title: Evidence export matches stored messages, hashes, organisations and people
checks: T4 evidence export matches messages, hashes, organisations and people

requirements.title: Mobile 390 / 768 / 1440 layouts
checks: T6 1440px: no horizontal overflow, composer usable, panel opens
T6 768px: no horizontal overflow, composer usable, panel opens
T6 390px: no horizontal overflow, composer usable, panel opens

requirements.title: Network loss and recovery: unsent message kept, resent once, catch-up, order preserved
checks: O1 both parties are online in the same room
O2 while A is offline the message is kept and marked as not sent
O3 B keeps talking meanwhile and does not see the unsent message
O4 back online: A resends once, B receives it, A catches up with B without reload
O5 B offline then online: B reload shows the full ordered history

requirements.title: Scope integrity of the synthetic tenant

allowedNotRun: AI with the real model (answer quality, latency)
T6 soft keyboard on a physical phone
